You do not need permission, a badge or a manager. You need a laptop and an afternoon.

<span id="your-first-afternoon"></span>
== Your first afternoon ==

# Read [[Mission and vision]] and [[Rules of the road]]. The clean-room rules are not optional.
# Join [https://discord.gg/jZYA3r27tG Discord] and the [https://github.com/occupysaas GitHub organization].
# Pick a way in:
#* '''Write code:''' pick an open issue, follow the clean-room policy, open a pull request.
#* '''Self-host it:''' run a release against your real SDKs and tell us exactly where it breaks.
#* '''Write specs:''' turn public docs into precise, testable specifications for the builders.
#* '''Make noise:''' star the repos, share the site, and tell your CFO what you are paying per seat.
# Run something: try [[ZeroAuthy]] with its Docker command, or the [[SalesCompel]] compatibility laboratory.
# Tell someone on Discord what you did and what confused you. Fix this page if you can.

<span id="before-you-contribute-code"></span>
== Before you contribute code ==

If you worked for one of the vendors whose products we replicate, read [[Rules of the road]] first and ask before touching that project.
